select cast(a.id as char) id,a.business_type businessType,cast(a.business_id as char) businessId, cast(a.file_id as char) fileId,f.original_name fileName,f.content_type contentType,f.size_bytes sizeBytes, a.category,a.note,a.created_at createdAt from fs_business_attachment a join fs_file_metadata f on f.id=a.file_id and f.deleted=0 where a.business_type=#{businessType} and a.business_id=#{businessId} and a.deleted=0 order by a.id desc
